required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 38 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON with schema_version=1?
Is decision status APPROVED and mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as background only?
Is the previous audited outcome correctly recorded as REWORK_REQUIRED?
Is this round limited to state-manifest freshness and its gate/report coverage?
What stale decision_id, round_id, report_id, generated_at, SHA-256, or size values were observed in the pre-rework state_manifest.json?
Does regenerated state_manifest.json match decision_20260710_state_manifest_freshness_rework_v1?
Does regenerated state_manifest.json match round_20260710_state_manifest_freshness_rework_v1?
Does regenerated state_manifest.json use the current report_id?
Does state_manifest.json remain artifact_kind=governance_index?
Does state_manifest.json continue to state that project_state files remain audit fact sources?
Does state_manifest.json avoid claiming that it replaces underlying fact sources?
Do current manifest references for decision_packet.md match the live SHA-256 and size?
Do current manifest references for codex_execution_report.md and execution_report.md match live SHA-256 and size values?
Does the current manifest reference for pytest_result.txt match the live SHA-256 and size?
Does the current manifest reference for command_plan.json match the live SHA-256 and size?
Does the current manifest reference for execution_log.json match the live SHA-256 and size?
Does the current manifest reference for final_gate_result.json match the live SHA-256 and size?
Does the current manifest reference for report_summary_synthesis.json match the live SHA-256 and size?
Does the current manifest reference for run_closeout_result.json match the live SHA-256 and size after closeout?
Does manifest validation reject a stale decision_id?
Does manifest validation reject a stale round_id?
Does manifest validation or final-check reject a stale current artifact SHA-256?
Does manifest validation or final-check reject a stale current artifact size?
Does final_gate_result.json include and pass the state-manifest freshness check?
Does final_gate_result.json pass for the current decision and round?
Does current_context_packet.json match the current decision and round after post-final sync?
Does post_final_evidence_sync_result.json report PASSED with context_generated_after_final_gate=true?
Does command_plan.json exist and pass with explicit pytest, report-summary, execution-log, final-check, run-closeout, and close-round coverage?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Does pytest_result.txt record the exact pytest command, exit code 0, and tests/test_project_state_manifest.py?
Do execution_log.json and pytest_result.txt agree on commands, exits, decision_id, and round_id?

Were current_state.json, task_packet.json, artifact_index.json, negative_results.json, roadmap/workstreams.json, domains, frontend, workflows, solve_reports, training materials, archives, deletions, blob_store, databases, and docs/roadmap left untouched?
Does run_closeout_result.json report PASSED and close_round_result CLOSED?
Does the new round_manifest exist and agree with live reports, pytest, decision, and closeout state?
Do execution_report.md and codex_execution_report.md agree on IDs, status, acceptance recommendation, tests, and generated artifacts?
Does the Required Audit body use actual observed manifest values rather than policy-only or template answers?
